set_do_not_disturb.name: Set do not disturb
set_do_not_disturb.description: Settings action for one CatGenie. This is the native action form, not a device-page time entity. Enabled clocks are converted on the selected IANA zone and reference date (today in that zone if omitted) to UTC HH:MM:SS, matching the official app's current-date save. Overnight windows use that same date for both ends. This is not a DST-safe recurring wall-clock guarantee, and firmware timezone or DST fields are not rewritten. Disable sends two empty clocks; firmware acceptance of this integration write is unverified. No automatic DST resave. The action does not enforce the app UI's ten-hour cap; that is not a proven server limit.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: CatGenie device. Not a raw vendor id.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Off sends two empty clocks without inventing times; firmware acceptance of this integration write is unverified.

end_time.name: End
end_time.description: Local end when enabled. Overnight windows stay on the same reference date.

timezone.name: Time zone
timezone.description: IANA zone for this save. Required when enabled. Not the host zone and not configuration.timezone.

reference_date.name: Reference date
reference_date.description: Defaults to today in the selected zone.

set_schedule.name: Set cleaning schedule
set_schedule.description: Replace the cleaning schedule from a native action form. This is not a device-page calendar and not a JSON text box. Each row is one local wall clock. The action converts every clock on the reference date in the required IANA zone and PUTs only {schedule: [UTC HH:mm:ss]}. It does not send mode, manual, Do Not Disturb, cat delay, volume, or auto-lock. An empty list is refused. Stored UTC clocks do not guarantee the same wall time after a DST change; nothing here resaves.

times.name: Local clocks
times.description: One to eight objects with a time field in zero-padded HH:mm:ss (seconds required, not HH:mm). Clocks must be unique and at least 120 minutes apart in both directions, including midnight.

zone.name: IANA time zone
zone.description: Explicit IANA zone, not configuration.timezone, a fixed offset, or the Home Assistant or device zone.

reference_date.name: Reference date
reference_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; omit to use today in the selected zone. An empty string is refused. Every clock uses this date, not the next day.
